title: Podcasts feature documentation
description: Update CLAUDE.md to note: (1) the Podcasts tab exists with headphones icon; (2) CF-Access headers are injected into audio streams via AVURLAssetHTTPHeaderFieldsKey in AudioPlayerViewModel — the same Cloudflare domain applies to audio URLs; (3) DateDisplay.parseISO8601 now has a date-only fallback (yyyy-MM-dd) after the two full ISO-8601 passes; (4) out-of-scope items for a future iteration: MPNowPlayingInfoCenter/lock-screen remote controls, offline episode caching, episode script view.
acceptance_criteria: CLAUDE.md documents the Podcasts tab and its position in the tab bar
AVURLAssetHTTPHeaderFieldsKey CF-Access injection pattern is documented
date-only ISO-8601 fallback in DateDisplay is documented
Out-of-scope v1 items are noted for future reference
